title: Connection issue with Dana-i pump (Korean version)
body:
**Pump model**: Dana-i  
**Serial number**: XML10046GI  
**Region**: Korea  
**Phone**: Samsung SM-S911N  
**Android version**: 15
**AAPS version**: 3.3.2.0  

[Log file](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20518170/AndroidAPS.log)

---

### Problem:

The pump appears in the Bluetooth list and briefly reacts when I attempt to connect from AAPS, but the connection drops within seconds.

I’ve ensured that:

- The official Dana app is closed
- Bluetooth pairing is reset
- All permissions are granted to AAPS
- The pump and phone times are matched

---

### Log snippet:

```text
[QueueWorker.doWorkAndLog():152]: queue empty. disconnect  
[QueueWorker.doWorkAndLog():156]: disconnected
```
Could you please help me understand what may be causing this disconnection?
Thank you for your time and support.

comments.body:
`Reply not received BASAL__GET_PROFILE_NUMBER`
This is the issue. Doesn't have Korean Dana-i some simple mode like RS? It must be turned off.
Best ask in korean group or Sooil
Thank you very much. Currently I can’t turn off the Easy Mode. I’ll contact Sooil to ask about this. Really appreciate your help.
Thank you so much for your help. I've successfully connected to AAPS. I really appreciate it!
@haein98 what was missing? maybe we should update wiki .....

The issue was caused by Easy Mode not being turned off.
To disable it: press and hold the three buttons except "OK", enter the password 3022, and you will find the option to turn off Easy Mode.
After that, AAPS connected and worked normally.
Thank you very much for your help.
